@dogecoin_empire Dogecoin comes into the pic, cause I wanted an in-game doge that could be purchased using dogecoin. The doge would help you solve puzzles. Make him sit on buttons. ect... while teaching you to give commands in Jap.

@dogecoin_empire I want to make a Japanese language learning simulator that utilizes blockchain tech. Like an old school text adventure. Except the text you input is Japanese, and it teaches you by modifying the game. This could then be simplified and abstracted to teach coding languages.
